description: The bar chart, titled “QA-1,” illustrates the performance breakdown of three Korean-language large language models—Llama-3-Open-Ko-8B, EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0, and RedWhale (our)—across three response categories: “Correct,” “Partially Correct,” and an unlabeled third category (represented by light blue, likely “Incorrect” or “Other”), as indicated by the legend at the bottom. The horizontal axis represents the proportion of responses falling into each category, ranging from 0 to approximately 1.0, while the vertical axis lists the models. For Llama-3-Open-Ko-8B, the stacked bar shows 0.88 for “Correct” (dark purple), 0.08 for “Partially Correct” (medium blue), and 0.04 for the third category (light blue). EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0 and RedWhale (our) both show identical performance: 0.96 for “Correct,” 0 for “Partially Correct,” and 0.04 for the third category. The chart visually emphasizes that both EEVE and RedWhale achieve higher accuracy than Llama-3-Open-Ko-8B, with no partially correct responses and a higher proportion of fully correct answers, suggesting superior performance on this QA benchmark. The models are listed in descending order of “Correct” score, with EEVE and RedWhale tied at the top.
